limits: Only inherited main-table cells plus the two registered Oct10 later runs are scanned; this is not an exhaustive index of every local experiment.
Paper values are copied from archived primary EADP Tables1/2/4, with HTML SHA and matrix equality checked. Printed paper averages remain reported values.

Local checks establish an existing score-to-raw-answer provenance chain and count/SHA checks, not a fresh benchmark re-score or proof of protocol correctness. Exact question-ID coverage and GT identity are not independently re-audited here.
Unsupported summary-only, rounded-only or directly supplied numbers are quarantined. Quarantine is not evidence that the underlying experiment never happened.
Historical per-cell best values retain their old selection and recipe caveats; no new maxima or fair paired method claims are produced.
Missing local benchmark scores are not replaced by paper values. Raw predictions remain in the original read-only source workspace.
